title: Private Nashville to Memphis Graceland Day Trip up to 7 Guests
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
This trip is 12-14 hours total. This includes 3.5 hours drive time, each way.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Enjoy a spacious and comfortable ride, from Nashville to Memphis, with a Tennessee tour guide. Tennessee stories, history, picturesque scenery, and good conversation, along the way. *substitute karaoke at no additional charge.

Once we arrive in Memphis, tour Elvis’ Graceland, Sun Studio, and take a quick ride through downtown Memphis. Then, you can choose to take in the beautiful views of the Mississippi River from atop the Bass Pro Pyramid, hang out on Beale St, visit the National Civil Rights Museum at the Lorraine Motel, see the ducks at The Peabody, have some BBQ, and/or choose from many other options. 

This is a full day adventure, but very much worth the visit to the birthplace of Rock and Roll.
